title: Triton Bidder Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Triton bidder: the Triton station and dsp-service ad tag of a placement, the per-format switches, and the settings of the two paths (banner via dsp-service RTB; audio/video via a VAST wrapper to Triton's on-demand request when baseUrl is set, else to dsp-service's VAST endpoint).

stid.description: Triton station id (placement id on Triton's side), sent to dsp-service in ext.cxr and to Triton as stid

tagId.description: dsp-service ad tag id of the placement, the {tag} path segment of the RTB and VAST endpoints. Usually sent by the SDK as imp.ext.data.tagId, which overrides this value; required one way or the other (the bidder reports the impression otherwise)

brandId.description: dsp-service brand id of the ad tag, used as the {brand} path segment and ext.cxr.brand_id when it differs from the Prebid Server account (publisher id); defaults to the publisher id

adRequestUrl.description: the dsp-service RTB URL the provider record names (https://…/goservices/dsp/rtb/{brand}/{tag}); only its brand and tag path segments are read, as defaults for brandId and tagId. The host is ignored: endpoints are Prebid Server config

hostRender.description: banner: render mode; server = dsp-service finishes the creative (default), client = dsp-service hands the device a boot creative (ext.cxr.pa = 1)

cpm.description: audio/video: the price the Triton wrapper bid competes at (CPM, USD); defaults to 0.05

baseUrl.description: audio/video: Triton's on-demand ad request base, e.g. https://cmod-na.live.streamtheworld.com/ondemand/ars (absolute https). When set, audio and video wrapper bids point at Triton directly with the documented request parameters; when absent they point at dsp-service's VAST endpoint for the ad tag

feedType.description: audio/video with baseUrl: Triton feed-type of the inventory

enabled.description: false turns the bidder off for the placement (no request, no bid); absent = enabled

formats.description: per-format switches; an absent object or field means enabled

audio.description: Triton wrapper bids for audio impressions

video.description: Triton wrapper bids for video impressions

banner.description: dsp-service RTB requests for banner impressions
